businesses.business: regulated electric and natural gas utilities

offering_description.value: Utility holding company that generates, transmits and distributes electricity and distributes natural gas to residential, commercial, industrial and wholesale customers. It operates regulated utilities in several US states and owns power generation assets.

primary_services.value: electric transmission and distribution; natural gas distribution; power generation

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential electric and gas customers; B2B: commercial and industrial customers, wholesale power buyers, cooperatives; B2G: municipal and government accounts

end_markets.value: residential energy; commercial and industrial energy; wholesale power; data centers; agriculture and mining

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: regulated rates for electricity and gas delivered to customers; product sales: wholesale power and gas sales under contracts
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs generation plants, transmission lines and gas distribution networks serving end customers; service provider: buys fuel and power and delivers utility service to retail and wholesale customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Arkansas, Colorado, Iowa, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska, South Dakota and Wyoming

specialization.value: related lines: electric utilities, natural gas utilities and power generation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility service delivered through own networks to retail customers and wholesale buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rate-regulated utilities overseen by state public utility commissions, FERC and environmental rules
